name: R01 every core-tier mermaid type renders and the surrounding text is intact

args.body:
# Weekly brief

Opening paragraph alpha.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  A[Draft] --> B[Review] --> C[Send]
```

Paragraph after flowchart number 1.

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  Hermes->>Head: PUT card
  Head-->>Hermes: 201 Created
```

Paragraph after sequenceDiagram number 2.

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> open
  open --> decided
  open --> superseded
  decided --> superseded
```

Paragraph after stateDiagram-v2 number 3.

```mermaid
gantt
  title Release M4
  dateFormat YYYY-MM-DD
  section Build
  Implement :a1, 2026-10-01, 5d
  Test      :after a1, 3d
```

Paragraph after gantt number 4.

```mermaid
timeline
  title A day
  Morning : Mail reader drafts a reply
  Evening : Day view
```

Paragraph after timeline number 5.

```mermaid
pie title Decisions this week
  "Approved" : 7
  "Rejected" : 2
  "Edited" : 1
```

Paragraph after pie number 6.

```mermaid
xychart-beta
  title "Cards per day"
  x-axis [Mon, Tue, Wed]
  y-axis "Cards" 0 --> 20
  bar [5, 12, 8]
  line [5, 12, 8]
```

Paragraph after xychart-beta number 7.
